architecture.compiled: Keep compiled code thin: transport, geometry and validation of normal public-client operations.
architecture.lua: Express goals, nested finite-state machines and task stacks as reusable Lua behavior rather than separate quest or class switches.
architecture.progress: Persist durable observed progress and correlated receipts; requests, casts and transport alone do not prove outcomes.
architecture.delivery: Use one shared implementation with coordinated owners and independent reviewers; reuse primitives instead of duplicate quest/class controllers.
